analytic_obligations.lambda-normalization: Along t->tv with G(v)=1, dG/dt=2t. Thus lambda=Mprime/(2t)<0; the real Euler radial vector p instead gives t Mprime/(2t^2), the same value.

analytic_obligations.complex-tangent: A regular real hypersurface has a complex tangent hyperplane H=TSigma intersect iTSigma, of complex dimension N-1.
analytic_obligations.real-to-complex: Adding real Hessian inequalities for a tangent vector and its complex rotation gives the Levi inequality on H; the common positive normalization does not affect the sign.
analytic_obligations.psh-sign: LG>=0 and lambda<0 imply Lpsi restricted H<=lambda LG restricted H<=0.

analytic_obligations.flat-global-G: Constant unitary transitions preserve G; the descended squared norm is smooth, positive off zero, complex-two-homogeneous and psh.
